catalogDescription: Upload a founder document and get a concise summary with takeaways, risks, and next questions.
title: Founder PDF Summarizer
subtitle: Turn a dense founder PDF into a fast, structured read.
descriptionBody:
Founders do not just deal with pitch decks. They deal with investor memos, grant documents, market reports, and long internal PDFs that take too long to parse when a decision is needed quickly.

Founder PDF Summarizer turns one uploaded PDF into a concise founder-facing summary with key takeaways, risk flags, and next questions so you can understand the file before you disappear into a full read.
section1Title: A fast read before the deep read
section1Body: Upload the PDF, choose the lens, and get a structured summary that focuses on what matters for a founder or startup operator. The result is meant to speed up decisions, not replace careful review where the stakes are high.

features.name: Founder-specific summary modes
features.desc: Choose a general founder read, pitch deck lens, investor memo lens, grant document lens, or market report lens.

features.name: Structured takeaways
features.desc: Get one executive summary, key takeaways, risk flags, and next questions instead of a vague paragraph.

features.name: Image-heavy PDF support
features.desc: The first version sends the full PDF directly for analysis so image-heavy pages still contribute to the result.

features.name: Markdown export
features.desc: Copy or download the summary as a clean Markdown file for docs, Notion, or founder notes.

whyTitle: Why use this instead of skimming manually?

whyPoints.title: Faster first-pass clarity
whyPoints.desc: Useful when you need to understand the file before deciding whether to keep reading, share it, or act on it.

whyPoints.title: Founder lens instead of generic chat
whyPoints.desc: The output is designed around startup decisions, missing proof, and practical next questions.

whyPoints.title: Works across multiple founder document types
whyPoints.desc: The same tool can help on decks, memos, grant documents, and market research PDFs.

footerSummaryDetails: (Free while we validate quality, file limits, and the strongest document modes).
footerResultDetails: A concise founder-ready summary you can copy, export, and use as a decision brief.
whoThisIsFor: Founders reviewing pitch decks, memos, and market documents quickly.
Operators preparing for investor, customer, or grant conversations.
Advisors or analysts who need a fast structured read before deeper review.

faq.q: Does this replace legal or financial review?
faq.a: No. It is a founder-first summary tool, not a substitute for legal or expert advice.

faq.q: What files work in the first version?
faq.a: The MVP is focused on PDF uploads under the file-size limit shown in the tool.
Yes. You can copy the summary or download it as Markdown.
